integrity: Exact exhaustive integer and permutation computations, reconstructed from portable source files; two differently constructed verification routines. Prior chamber counts and root-system classification are attributed to their sources.
scientific_limitations: The table is conditional on the full Frobenius Weyl conjugacy class, and the 27-line cycle partition alone does not always identify that class. No assertion that every Weyl class occurs over every finite field; no independent external scientific validation or absolute historical priority claim.
title: Twenty-five Frobenius spectra of Zariski chambers on smooth cubic surfaces
